selection_rubric: Explain in at least 100 characters how independent mechanisms will be compared, how duplicate ideas will be detected, how evidence quality affects ordering, and how blocked families will be handled.

families.mechanism: At least 60 characters describing the distinct mechanism, not merely a model or parameter name.
families.causal_claim: At least 50 characters stating why this mechanism should improve the official within-user ranking metric.
families.smallest_experiment: At least 40 characters describing the smallest decisive official experiment.
families.falsifier: At least 30 characters describing a concrete observation that would reject the claim.
families.known_risks: At least 20 characters naming leakage, overfit, compute, or implementation risks.

families.smallest_experiment: State the smallest experiment that could distinguish this claim from the incumbent.
families.falsifier: State the result that would make the agent stop pursuing this family.
families.known_risks: State the most important concrete risks.
